// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-COUNT-WILDCARD
// _count: true inside a select counts EVERY relation on the row. On a Parent
// that is the linked-children count R11 refuses, obtained without naming the
// relation the gate is watching for.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function parentByEmail(email) {
  return db.parent.findUnique({ where: { email }, select: { id: true, _count: true } });
}
